zh: 匯豐客戶可透過代幣化貨幣市場基金使用RedCoin

work.en: HSBC customers in Hong Kong can now use HSBC RedCoin to access a tokenised money market fund. Customers must first activate a stablecoin wallet within the HSBC HK Mobile Banking App.
